# Deep Research Dossier: Zero-Knowledge Verification ## Executive Summary Zero-knowledge proof systems provide cryptographic verification of computational integrity without revealing witness data. ## Benchmark Analysis - **Groth16**: Minimal proof size (128 bytes), trusted setup required. - **PlonK**: Universal SRS, quadratic prover overhead. - **STARKs**: Transparent setup, quantum-resistant, larger proof footprint.
